request: Analyze GSE208354 for PMID 36120562 (Exercise training ameliorates myocardial phenotypes in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction by changing N6-methyladenosine modification in mice model.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: MeRIP-seq (m6A IP) plus input RNA-seq of mouse heart; the input libraries are the mRNA-expression arm (S2.7.p1, S2.8.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 8 weeks moderate treadmill exercise on heart mRNA expression in two-hit (HFD + L-NAME) HFpEF mice: HFpEF+EXT vs sedentary HFpEF
final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 male C57BL/6J HFpEF and 3 HFpEF+EXT hearts for RNA-seq (S2.8.p1, S3.4.p1 'n = 3 per group'); IP libraries are the m6A arm, not expression
planned_contrasts: HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF (S3.4.p1; paper: 690 DEGs, 267 up, 423 down)
final.normalization: featureCounts then DESeq2 (S2.8.p1); FPKM shown in Fig 3A
final.paper_method: DESeq2 on featureCounts counts, two groups (S2.8.p1)
final.paper_results: 690 DEGs (267 up, 423 down) HFpEF+EXT vs HFpEF; Table 3 mRNA log2FC: Casp12 -1.27, Capn2 -0.31, Fas -1.03, Casp7 -0.54, Jun -0.99, Pdia3 -0.50, Tnnt2 +0.73, Mef2a +0.44, Adrb1 +0.53, Agtr1a +0.53

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Exercise effect within HFpEF mice. The paper's 'control' in GEO is the sedentary HFpEF group (S1.p4 'HFpEF + EXT and control (HFpEF) mice'). The m6A peak / differential methylation results are a different assay and are out of scope for gene expression.

method.reasoning: Matrix-method policy: log-transformed FPKM goes to limma. A low-expression filter avoids zero-inflated near-constant genes distorting the limma-trend prior.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule (raw p < 0.05, FC > 2) applied to limma results instead of DESeq2; BH FDR < 0.05 reported as audit.

threshold.reasoning: S3.4.p1 and Fig 3B: fold change > 2 and p < 0.05 (raw p) -> |log2FC| > 1.
